ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows triangle QRS, with vertex R above, Q at the lower left, and S at the lower right. Each of the three sides has one identical pink tick mark, indicating that the three sides QR, RS, and QS are congruent. The left side QR is labeled 5x, the right side RS is labeled 6x - 5, and the base QS is labeled 3x + 10. The problem asks to find RS. Reasoning: Because the three sides have identical tick marks, QR = RS = QS. According to the method, take QR = RS, obtaining 5x = 6x - 5. Moving terms gives x = 5. Substitute x = 5 into RS = 6x - 5, giving RS = 6(5) - 5 = 30 - 5 = 25.
